shots.prompt: Wide shot of a narrow forest road at night, bare branches closing overhead, thin moonlight, a single armoured figure walking away from camera with an enormous sword on his back
shots.motion: He walks steadily away down the road. Branches shift overhead. Something moves in the trees on both sides and does not show itself.
shots.say: There is a mark on his neck that bleeds when the dead come close. It has not stopped bleeding in two years.
shots.sfx: A night forest road, bare branches, something large moving through undergrowth on both sides, no birds

shots.prompt: Extreme macro close-up of a brand at the base of a neck in moonlight, a small mark shaped like a wound, fresh blood welling out of it and running down
shots.motion: Blood wells out of the mark and runs down the skin. The mark seems to pulse faintly. Steam rises off it in the cold.
shots.say: It is a summons, and everything on the other side can read it.
shots.sfx: A wet trickle, a faint impossible heartbeat, cold air, dread

shots.prompt: Violent night action shot of a hunched grotesque creature lunging out of the treeline at {GUTS}, all limbs and teeth, the enormous sword already swinging up to meet it, moonlight
shots.motion: The thing comes out of the trees fast and low. He brings the great sword round into it without breaking stride.
shots.motion2: Two more come from behind; he turns the swing into a full circle and clears the road around him
shots.motion3: The last one drags itself away into the dark; he stands in the road breathing, and starts walking again
shots.sfx: Something bursting out of undergrowth, a huge blade meeting flesh, inhuman shrieking, then a road at night again

shots.prompt: Breathtaking wide establishing shot at dawn of a green mountain valley from above, terraced fields impossibly lush, a prosperous stone village at the centre, orchards heavy with fruit, mist in the low ground
shots.motion: Mist lifts off the terraces. The fields move in the wind, unnaturally green and heavy. Smoke rises straight up from the chimneys.
shots.say: In the morning he came over a ridge and found a valley that had not had a bad harvest in nineteen years.
shots.sfx: A mountain valley at dawn, birdsong, wind through heavy crops, a distant bell, everything too pleasant

shots.prompt: Shot of {GUTS} walking through a stone village gate, villagers in good clothes stopping to stare at him, well-fed children, baskets of fruit, warm morning light
shots.motion: The villagers stop what they are doing and watch him pass. Nobody greets him. A woman pulls a child behind her skirts.
shots.say: They were fed, and clothed, and afraid of him rather than of anything else.
shots.sfx: A prosperous village morning, carts, livestock, conversation dropping to silence as someone passes

shots.prompt: Medium shot of {MIRA} in an inn doorway with a cloth over one shoulder, watching the stranger in the street with open direct curiosity rather than fear
shots.motion: She leans in the doorway and looks him up and down without dropping her eyes. She says something short. The cloth shifts on her shoulder.
shots.say: You are the first person to come up that road in nine months. Nobody comes here. Nobody leaves either.
shots.sfx: An inn doorway, a street beyond, cloth, a young woman's voice, cups inside

shots.prompt: Unsettling shot of a village square in afternoon light, adults and older children going about their business, and a conspicuous absence, no small children anywhere in the frame
shots.motion: The square is busy with adults and teenagers. Nothing under about ten years old crosses the frame at any point. Slow drift across.
shots.say: It took him half a day to work out what was wrong with the place.
shots.sfx: A busy square, adults, older children, no infant sounds at all, a well, birds

shots.prompt: Ominous shot of a bronze bell in a stone tower being rung at dusk, the village below assembling in the square in complete silence, long shadows
shots.motion: The bell swings and tolls. Below, the villagers file into the square without being told, and stand still, and wait.
shots.say: At dusk the bell rang, and the whole valley came to the square without being called twice.
shots.sfx: A bronze bell tolling over a valley, hundreds of feet on stone, then total silence

shots.prompt: Imposing shot of {VASK} on a stone balcony above the square, a tall silver-bearded lord in a heavy fur-collared coat, hands resting on the balustrade, torches on either side of him
shots.motion: He rests both hands on the balustrade and looks down over them without hurrying. The torches gutter. Nobody in the square looks up.
shots.say: Lord Vask had held the valley for nineteen years, which was exactly as long as the good harvests had lasted.
shots.sfx: A stone balcony above a crowd, torches, a heavy coat, a crowd holding its breath

shots.prompt: Shot of a small girl's hand drawing a wooden token from a clay jar held by a village elder, the crowd pressed close around, torchlight, absolute stillness
shots.motion: The hand goes into the jar and comes out with a token. The elder takes it and reads it. Nobody moves at all.
shots.say: They drew a name the way other places draw lots for who mends the road.
shots.sfx: A hand in a clay jar, a wooden token, a name read out flatly, a crowd not reacting

shots.prompt: Devastating shot of {MIRA} in the crowd going completely still, one hand closing on the shoulder of a small boy beside her, the crowd around them already looking away
shots.motion: Her hand closes hard on the boy's shoulder. Around her, people lower their eyes and begin to turn away. She does not make a sound.
shots.say: Her brother was six.
shots.sfx: A crowd beginning to disperse, cloth, a hand gripping a shoulder, no crying

shots.prompt: Wrenching wide shot of the square as the crowd bows toward the balcony in unison, {MIRA} standing upright and alone in the middle of the bowing crowd holding the boy
shots.motion: The whole crowd bows in one motion. She stays standing, holding the boy against her, the only vertical figure in the frame.
shots.say: Then they bowed, and thanked him, and went home to their suppers.
shots.sfx: Hundreds of people bowing in unison, a murmured formula of thanks, feet dispersing on stone

shots.prompt: Tense interior shot of a lamplit inn at night, {GUTS} at a table and a heavy grey-haired innkeeper across from him with a jug, other villagers listening from the shadows
shots.motion: The innkeeper sets the jug down and sits without being asked. He speaks steadily. The listeners in the shadows do not move.
shots.say: One child a year. Nineteen years. No famine, no plague, no army has ever come up that road.
shots.sfx: A quiet lamplit inn, a jug set on wood, a low steady voice, people listening without moving

shots.prompt: Close-up of {GUTS} at the table, one hand around a cup he is not drinking from, iron hand flat on the wood, listening with a flat dangerous expression
shots.motion: The iron hand flexes slowly on the table. He does not touch the cup. His eye stays on the man opposite.
shots.say: And you agreed to it.
shots.sfx: An iron hand on wood, a cup untouched, a room gone quiet

shots.prompt: Shot of the innkeeper leaning back, absolutely unashamed, gesturing at the room and the village beyond with one hand, other villagers nodding in the shadows behind him
shots.motion: He leans back and gestures around the room, and the people in the shadows nod slowly along with him. He is not defending himself. He is explaining.
shots.say: We voted. Twice. My own daughter's name has been in that jar nineteen times. Before him we buried four children a winter.
shots.sfx: A room agreeing quietly, cups, a fire, nodding, terrible reasonableness

shots.prompt: Quiet devastating shot of {MIRA} outside in the dark behind the inn, back against the wall, the small boy asleep in her arms, her face wet and furious
shots.motion: She holds the sleeping boy and stares at nothing. Her jaw works. She does not let herself make any noise that would carry.
shots.say: I voted for it too. Last year. When it was someone else's brother.
shots.sfx: A cold yard at night, a child breathing asleep, someone crying without sound, wind

shots.prompt: Eerie wide shot of a torchlit procession climbing a mountain path at night, the villagers walking in an orderly line, a small figure carried at the front, mist and rock
shots.motion: The line of torches winds up the path steadily. Nobody hurries. Nobody speaks. The mist swallows the head of the procession.
shots.say: They took him up the mountain at midnight, and they went willingly, and that was the part he could not get past.
shots.sfx: A slow torchlit procession on rock, many feet, no voices, wind, a bell somewhere below

shots.prompt: Ominous shot of a flat stone shelf high on the mountain, a shallow bowl worn into the rock, the villagers ringed around it with torches, {VASK} standing at its edge with his coat off
shots.motion: He folds the heavy coat and hands it to someone. The ring of torches closes. He steps to the edge of the worn bowl and waits.
shots.sfx: A high stone shelf, wind, torches guttering, cloth folded, a crowd arranged in a ring

shots.prompt: Terrifying transformation shot on the mountain shelf, the lord's body splitting open and unfolding upward into something enormous and many-limbed, torches blown flat, villagers on their knees
shots.motion: The body comes apart and opens upward into something far too large for it, unfolding limb after limb. The torches blow flat. The villagers go down on their knees.
shots.motion2: The thing settles onto its new limbs and lowers a long head toward the small figure at the centre of the ring
shots.motion3: {GUTS} comes through the ring of kneeling villagers at a run with the enormous sword already up and takes the head off its approach
shots.say: What Lord Vask had traded away, he had traded a long time ago.
shots.sfx: Flesh and bone unfolding wetly on a huge scale, torches blown out, a crowd falling to its knees, then a huge blade

shots.prompt: Explosive action shot of {GUTS} mid-air bringing the enormous sword down onto the many-limbed creature on the mountain shelf, torch fire scattered, rock cracking beneath them
shots.motion: He comes down on it with the whole weight of the sword. Rock splits under the impact. The thing screams and throws him off.
shots.motion2: It catches him with a limb and drives him across the shelf into the rock face; he comes out of the dust already moving
shots.motion3: He goes in under its guard and takes two limbs off at the joint; it rears back and the whole shelf shakes
shots.motion4: It pins him under one huge limb and leans down over him; he gets the iron hand into its jaw and holds it off
shots.motion5: He tears free, comes up the length of its body and drives the sword down through the base of the long head
shots.sfx: A colossal blade on rock and flesh, a creature screaming, stone cracking, a body thrown into a cliff, sustained brutal combat

shots.prompt: Shocking shot of the villagers rising from their knees and coming at {GUTS} from behind with torches, stones and farm tools, faces contorted with rage, the wounded creature behind him
shots.motion: They come up off their knees and rush him from behind with whatever they are holding. He turns and sees them coming, and for a second does not understand.
shots.say: Then the village came at him. Not at the thing on the rock. At him.
shots.sfx: A crowd turning violent, stones, tools, screaming, feet on rock, complete confusion

shots.prompt: Close-up of the face of {GUTS} half lit by scattered torch fire, blood across it, understanding exactly what is happening and deciding to finish anyway
shots.motion: His face changes as he understands. He looks past the crowd to the thing behind them. He makes the decision and turns back toward it.
shots.say: He could have walked down the mountain. Nobody there wanted saving.
shots.sfx: Chaos held slightly back, breathing, fire, a decision

shots.prompt: Final brutal shot of the enormous creature collapsing onto the stone shelf, the great sword driven through it, {GUTS} standing on its body, the villagers frozen around them in torchlight
shots.motion: The huge body comes down onto the rock and stops moving. He stands on it with both hands on the hilt. The crowd goes completely still around him.
shots.sfx: An enormous body collapsing onto stone, a blade driven home, then absolute silence and wind

shots.prompt: Bleak dawn wide shot of the same green valley from the ridge, but the colour already draining out of the terraces, the crops greying at the edges, mist gone
shots.motion: The light comes up on the terraces and the green in them is already wrong, greying at the edges. The wind moves through them differently.
shots.say: By dawn the fields had already started to turn.
shots.sfx: A valley at dawn, wind through crops that sound dry, no birds, a village waking badly

shots.prompt: Devastating shot of the village street in grey morning light, villagers lining both sides in silence watching {GUTS} walk out, faces full of open hatred, one man holding a stone he does not throw
shots.motion: They line the street and watch him go. Nobody speaks. A man turns a stone over in his hand and does not throw it. He walks through it.
shots.say: Nineteen years of harvests had been bought and paid for, and he had just refused the last instalment on their behalf.
shots.sfx: A silent street, many people not speaking, boots on stone, a stone turned over in a hand

shots.prompt: Close two-shot at the village gate, {MIRA} holding her small brother's hand, looking at {GUTS} with something that is not gratitude and not hatred either
shots.motion: She stops in front of him with the boy's hand in hers. She looks up at him for a long moment and does not thank him. The boy stares.
shots.say: I do not know whether to kiss you or kill you. Neither does anyone else. Go, before they decide.
shots.sfx: A village gate in the morning, two people close, a child, wind, an unresolved goodbye

shots.prompt: Wide shot from behind of {GUTS} walking out of the valley up the ridge road, the greying terraces below him, the village small behind, grey sky
shots.motion: He walks up the ridge road away from camera. Below him the valley colour keeps draining. He does not look back at it.
shots.sfx: Boots on a ridge road, wind, a valley behind, emptiness ahead

shots.prompt: Striking shot on a high bare ridge at dusk of {ZODD} sitting on a boulder with its arms across its knees, entirely relaxed, watching the road, horns against the sky
shots.motion: It sits on the boulder without moving as he comes up the road, and turns only its head to follow him. It is not crouched to attack.
shots.say: Something was waiting on the ridge, and it had not come to fight.
shots.sfx: A high bare ridge at dusk, wind, something very large shifting its weight on stone

shots.prompt: Two-shot on the ridge of {GUTS} standing with the sword still on his back and {ZODD} seated on the boulder above him, neither of them in a fighting posture, cold sky behind
shots.motion: Neither of them moves toward the other. The beast tilts its head. He stands with his weight even, hand nowhere near the hilt.
shots.say: They spat at you. Threw stones at your back. Why spend anything on them at all.
shots.sfx: Wind on a ridge, a low inhuman voice, no weapons drawn, an odd calm

shots.prompt: Ominous wide shot from the ridge of a distant plain at dusk with an enormous host of lights moving across it, far too many, a white winged shape hanging in the air above them
shots.motion: The lights on the plain move in a single vast column. Above them the small white winged shape hangs perfectly still. Everything below it follows.
shots.say: The thing wearing your friend's face is gathering an army. Whole cities are opening their gates to it and calling it mercy.
shots.sfx: A vast distant host on the move, thousands of feet and horses, a chorus of adoration on the wind, dread

shots.prompt: Close-up of {GUTS} on the ridge in the last light, the brand at his neck bleeding again, looking out at the distant host rather than at the creature beside him
shots.motion: Blood runs from the mark at his neck. He watches the distant lights. He answers without turning his head.
shots.say: Then there will be more valleys like that one. Someone once told me a friend is somebody going somewhere of his own. I am going somewhere.
shots.sfx: Wind on a high ridge, blood running, a low steady voice, distance

shots.prompt: Shot of {ZODD} rising off the boulder to its full height against the dusk sky, head back, something like amusement on the bestial face, wings or arms spread
shots.motion: It stands up to its full height and throws its head back. The sound it makes is not quite a laugh. Then it looks down at him almost fondly.
shots.say: Good. Get stronger. When it finally kills you I want it to have cost something.
shots.sfx: Something enormous standing up on stone, a laugh that is not a laugh, wind, wings

shots.prompt: Final wide shot of {GUTS} walking down off the ridge into a darkening valley, the enormous sword on his back, the distant lights of the host on the horizon ahead of him, one small figure
shots.motion: He walks down off the ridge toward the distant lights. The sword rides on his back. The dark comes up around him. Very slow crane back.
shots.say: He was the only thing left walking toward it.
shots.sfx: Boots descending a ridge, wind, a vast distant host far ahead, one man alone
